name: Location Hotkeys
author: Captain Snail
description: Bind spots in Hush House to keys and jump straight back to them.
description_long: Press Page Up to enter bind mode, then press F5-F10 or F12 to save the current view to that key. Press that key at any other time to fly the camera back. Settings and saved locations live in location_hotkeys.json next to your save file.
